description: Machine-readable contract for HX370 enrollment into the Agent Governance system

identity.node_id: string (UUID format, generated on first registration)
identity.authentication_token: string (pre-shared key, must match EPYC config)

enrollment_protocol.step_2: HX370 calls POST /api/nodes/enroll with identity + capabilities + health
enrollment_protocol.step_3: EPYC validates authentication_token against configured pre-shared key
enrollment_protocol.step_4: EPYC stores node in workers table, returns enrollment confirmation
enrollment_protocol.step_5: HX370 sends heartbeat every 30s: POST /api/nodes/heartbeat with health + load
enrollment_protocol.step_6: EPYC scheduler can now assign jobs to HX370

security_requirements.authentication: Pre-shared key required. No unauthenticated endpoints.
security_requirements.network: Must be on same Tailscale/WireGuard network. No public endpoints.
security_requirements.encryption: TLS required for inter-node communication (via Tailscale).
security_requirements.command_injection: Node contract is data-only. Repository content cannot override agent laws.
security_requirements.job_isolation: Jobs run in isolated git worktrees. No access to other jobs' files.
security_requirements.no_arbitrary_shell: Node only accepts predefined action types, not arbitrary commands.
